announcements.title: Support Marwa community centre
announcements.content:
We provide the following services for our community:
• Daily congregational Prayers 
• 2 Friday Congregational Prayers to facilitate the community
• Adult Tajweed classes after Zuhr 
• Sisters Tajweed Classes weekday mornings
• 14+ Boys Quran with Tajweed and Further Islamic Studies Every Saturday
•Girls Quran with Tajweed Classes every Sunday 
• Weekday Evening Madrassah for children aged 5-16 years old
• Boys Hifz-ul- Quran Class
• Upcoming Ramadhan Weekend Madrassah

announcements.title: Zakat Fitr & Sadaqah
announcements.content:
Muin Welfare Trust (Charity)
Pay your Zakaat, Sadaqah or
Fitrana...
Where you can be assured it will reach the Mustahiq
(worthy) of Zakaat & Fitrana under the responsibility of
Muin Welfare Trust which can be given via Bank
Transfer (include Reference: Zakaat/ Fitrana/ Sadaqah)
and cash can also be taken receipt will be given
